claim.value: If hypotheses remain tied, rerun the comparison under a different workload.

target.text: Two export-delay hypotheses remain tied after a comparison at workload W. Workload independently affects latency. A repeat can hold W fixed or use W2; the proposed repeat uses W2 while comparing against the prior W run.

source_instrument.text: Paired diagnostic comparison requires workload to remain fixed across the compared runs. Vary only the suspected causal variable. Comparing different workloads cannot isolate that variable.

mapping.text: The team proposes a next-step rule if the hypotheses remain tied; it has not run the repeat.

content_origin.rationale: The target describes a proposed repeat at a different workload, but does not explicitly supply the conditional next-step rule. The mapping introduces that rule.

epistemic_function.rationale: It prescribes what to do if hypotheses remain tied. The rerun is subordinate to this prospective decision rule.
